chunks: And from his will (peace be upon him) to al-Hasan and al-Husayn (peace be upon them), when 'Abd al-Rahman ibn Muljam (may Allah curse him) struck him.

key_terms.ابْنُ مِلْجَمَ: Ibn Muljam, the assassin of Imam Ali

ai.seo_question: What is the context of Imam Ali's last will to Hasan and Husayn in Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: This heading introduces the 'Will of Imam Ali' (Wasiyyah), a pivotal text in Shia tradition that outlines the political and spiritual succession to Hasan and Husayn (peace be upon them) following the Prophet's lineage. It is historically significant as it was delivered in the Rawda of the Prophet in Kufa, just before Ali's return to the Great Mosque for his final prayer, marking the transition from the era of the Caliphate to the Imamate of the Ahl al-Bayt.
